used.attribution: Star and constellation-figure data: d3-celestial (c) 2015 Olaf Frohn, BSD-3-Clause
used_for: stars.json: ra, dec, mag, bv, hip
used.verdict: OK-attribution (BSD-3). Caveat 'verify upstream': the star values come from XHIP (Anderson & Francis 2012, CDS V/137D), itself compiled from the ESA Hipparcos catalogue, which ESA now distributes under CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO (commercial use needs ESA authorisation, data.licences@esa.int). Star positions/magnitudes are facts, but if the upstream claim matters use --strict. Lines/labels follow the IAU charts (CC BY 4.0).

rejected.name: Yale Bright Star Catalogue BSC5 (Hoffleit & Warren 1991; CDS V/50; HEASARC bsc5p)
rejected.verdict: verify / excluded: HEASARC states it provides the catalogue 'solely for the purposes of scientific research', does not own the copyright and cannot clarify commercial terms; Yale University Observatory and/or the authors may retain copyright.

rejected.name: Hipparcos and Tycho Catalogues (ESA SP-1200; CDS I/239, I/259 Tycho-2)
rejected.verdict: excluded: non-commercial. ESA science archive T&C (https://www.cosmos.esa.int/web/esdc/terms-and-conditions) require a request for authorisation/licence before any commercial use.

rejected.name: Gaia DR3 (ESA / DPAC)
rejected.verdict: excluded: non-commercial (page: 'Gaia data are distributed under the CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO license'); also saturates for the brightest stars.

rejected.name: SKY2000 Master Catalog v5 (Myers et al., NASA GSFC Flight Dynamics Division; CDS V/145)
rejected.verdict: verify / not adopted. Checked the CDS ReadMe (CfA mirror; CDS itself unreachable), the v5 rev 4 description (sky2kv5r4.pdf) and notes.txt: none contains a licence, terms of use, copyright or public-domain / US-government-work statement. HEASARC does not host it (no W3Browse sky2kv5 page, no table in the HEASARC TAP schema). The system documents it cites are Computer Sciences Corporation contractor reports, so federal-work status is not established. Its positions also come mostly from Hipparcos/Tycho (notes.txt: 95,332 HIP + 12,111 HIP components + 12,015 Tycho + 178,231 ACT positions), so it would not remove the ESA upstream question anyway.

rejected.name: HYG database v4.x (astronexus)
rejected.verdict: not used: share-alike, and compiled from Hipparcos (now ESA CC BY-NC) + Yale BSC (unclear) + Gliese, so the same upstream question as d3-celestial with an added SA obligation. d3-celestial (BSD-3) is the cleaner redistribution.
